published.description: Year the work was first published, not the reprint. 0 if unknown.

isbn.description: ISBN-13 of the chosen edition, 13 digits, no hyphens. Empty string if unverified.

genre.description: 3-5 values from the genre taxonomy in frontmatter.json.

coverImage.description: Site-absolute path of the downloaded cover, e.g. /images/books/covers/<slug>.jpg. Empty string if no cover was saved.

goodreadsUrl.description: Canonical Goodreads book URL. Empty string if it could not be verified.

notes.description: Uncertainties, conflicts between sources, and the LibraryThing work id used. For the human, not the file.
